entries.title: GREEN release vs Apple notarization pending
entries.description: Release readiness reports GREEN but macOS desktop distribution requires Apple notarization which is not yet completed. Electron builds cannot be distributed via standard macOS channels without notarization.
entries.mitigationPath: Complete Apple Developer enrollment and notarization workflow. Gate electron-signing-readiness already tracks this. Distribution verdict must remain DISTRIBUTION_BLOCKED until resolved.

entries.title: GREEN integration vs OAuth tokens unencrypted at rest
entries.description: Connector OAuth integration reports GREEN but token encryption at rest (AES-256-GCM) is defined in policy but not yet enforced at the database layer. Tokens are stored in connector_tokens table without column-level encryption.
entries.mitigationPath: Implement pgcrypto column-level encryption for access_token and refresh_token columns in connector_tokens. Update oauth-security-closure validator to verify encryption. Trust verdict must show TRUST_GAP_OPEN until resolved.

entries.title: GREEN OS vs E2E boot validation roadmap-only
entries.description: OS readiness reports GREEN but end-to-end boot validation (QEMU/ISO boot → login → shell) is classified as roadmap/deferred. No actual boot-to-login E2E test has executed in CI.
entries.mitigationPath: Implement CI-based QEMU boot validation or explicitly downgrade OS behavioral readiness to BEHAVIORALLY_PARTIAL. Structural readiness is unaffected.

entries.title: GREEN frontend vs 13 duplicate component families
entries.description: Frontend structural readiness reports GREEN but 13 component families have duplicate implementations (e.g., multiple card components, multiple modal implementations). This inflates component count and creates maintenance burden.
entries.mitigationPath: Consolidate duplicate families via component-canonicalization validator. Structural score receives 5-point penalty per unresolved duplicate family but does not block release.

entries.title: GREEN frontend vs 12 dead pages
entries.description: Frontend readiness reports GREEN but 12 pages are classified as dead (no inbound navigation, no route-guard, orphaned). These pages consume bundle size and create confusion.
entries.mitigationPath: Remove or archive dead pages. Validator no-shell-only-production-pages tracks this. 2-point structural penalty per dead page, non-blocking.

entries.title: GREEN mobile vs distribution-blocked (archived)
entries.description: Mobile scope is archived and honestly classified as out-of-scope, but legacy mobile readiness claims may still appear in generated artifacts. Distribution dimension must show DISTRIBUTION_BLOCKED for mobile subsystem.
entries.mitigationPath: Mobile scope closure gates (5 BLOCK) enforce honest classification. Mobile distribution verdict is explicitly DISTRIBUTION_BLOCKED. No action needed unless mobile is re-scoped.

entries.title: GREEN aggregate vs 4,252 advisory warnings
entries.description: Release aggregator reports GREEN (all BLOCK gates pass) but 4,252 advisory warnings exist across WARN-tier validators. This volume of advisories may mask emerging structural or behavioral issues.
entries.mitigationPath: Advisory interpretation policy defines thresholds: >5000 advisories forces CONDITIONALLY_READY, >2000 adds operational caveat. Current 4,252 triggers caveat but not downgrade. Warn-ratchet prevents growth.
